namePolicy.summary: What people will see in their conversation list and in search results.

errors.long: Keep the name to 60 characters or fewer.

topicPolicy.summary: Optional. One line on what belongs here, which owners and administrators can change later.

errors.long: Keep the topic to 200 characters or fewer.

tagPolicy.summary: Latin letters and numbers, an optional key:value colon, hyphens only between words.

errors.empty: Enter a tag before adding it.
errors.unicode: Tags use Latin letters and numbers only.
errors.hyphenEdge: A tag part cannot start or end with a hyphen.
errors.doubleHyphen: Use a single hyphen between words.
errors.colons: A tag can contain at most one colon, separating a key from a value.
errors.shape: That is not a valid tag.
errors.duplicate: That tag is already on this conversation.
errors.max: A conversation can carry at most 10 tags.

visibilityOptions.title: Listed
visibilityOptions.description: Appears in tag search with its tags visible. Anyone identified can join it.

visibilityOptions.title: Unlisted
visibilityOptions.description: Never named in search. Reachable only by someone who supplies every one of its tags.

matchingOptions.title: Any tag can find it
matchingOptions.description: The conversation appears when a search includes at least one of its tags.

matchingOptions.title: All tags required
matchingOptions.description: The conversation appears only when a search includes every one of its tags.
